# Known failures of the sami checks: tests that fail on every tree for a reason the tree does not
# own yet. The summary shows each failure as KNOWN (with this reason) or NEW; a unit whose only
# failures are known reads KNOWN, unless a test in it skipped itself and passed as no other user
# (then it is UNKNOWN). An entry whose test passed or no longer exists is listed in the summary to
# be removed, and the summary job fails until it is, so the list only shrinks.
# A flaky entry, whose reason starts with `flaky: `, names a test that fails in some runs and passes
# in others. When it fails, its job runs it again alone by name (set.sh: at most twice, as the same
# user, from the same binary); its failure reads KNOWN only when a retry passed, and NEW when every
# try failed. It is not listed for removal when it passes (it still is when its test no longer exists).
# A unit of `*` names the test in any unit of its row: a coding-agent shard holds the test files
# whose sorted index mod 10 is the shard's, so a file added before a test moves it to another shard.
# A known self-skip, whose reason starts with `skips: `, has a sixth field: the start of the skip
# line the test prints (each `{...}` any text). A test that skipped itself reads KNOWN when each of
# its skip lines starts as an entry of its row, user and test says; one user's entry never covers
# the other user, and a unit with any other self-skip (not passed as the other user) is UNKNOWN.
# An entry whose test ran without skipping itself, or printed no line that starts so, is listed
# for removal.
# One per line, tab-separated: <row> <user> <unit> <test> <reason> [<skip line start>].
# Rows: set-runner, set-root, builtins, workspace, ts-small, ts-ca (sc.py ROWS).
# Source: runs 45245119907 (509a2d77) and 45245136412 (a72018dd); red at both trees.
